title: Say how safe Cubric Studio is: keys, security policy, checksums
description: A browser agent judged cubric.studio and could not find that API keys are encrypted and never shown again (it is one line deep in /privacy/), and it said the code may be used in a commercial app (the FAQ says no). Fix: a Security section in llms.txt, a keys FAQ on the home page, a current SECURITY.md, private vulnerability reporting on, SHA-256 checksums on every release.
